system.description: A Focus for a swashbuckling daredevil whose flamboyant fighting style is entertaining to watch.

abilities.name: Attack Flourish
abilities.description: Stylish moves and quips give a nearby observer an asset on their next task.

abilities.name: Roguish Smile
abilities.description: Erase the last round from the memory of a nearby level 3 or lower target; Effort raises the maximum level.

abilities.name: Taunting Defense
abilities.description: Hinder a melee attack against you, but a hit inflicts one additional minor wound.

abilities.name: Dashing Defense
abilities.description: When using a light or medium weapon, attempt a block after failing to dodge an attack.

abilities.name: Fast Kill
abilities.description: A successful melee or ranged attack deals 4 additional damage, but not in consecutive rounds.

abilities.name: Wounded Fury
abilities.description: With severe wounds, gain one free level of Effort on an attack each round; at tier 3, gain two.

abilities.name: Acrobatic Attack
abilities.description: An acrobatic attack grants a free Effort level when you spend Effort on its roll, and a natural 17 or 18 can create a minor effect.

abilities.name: Flamboyant Boast
abilities.description: Boast about a difficult deed; success hinders witnesses' next turns, while failure hinders your attempts to influence them.

abilities.name: Quick Adjustment
abilities.description: A nonlethal attack becomes a First action.

abilities.name: Improved Dashing Defense
abilities.description: An ally nearby using a light or medium weapon gains Dashing Defense until your next turn.

abilities.name: Misdirect
abilities.description: When an opponent misses, redirect the attack to another nearby target with an unmodified attack roll.

abilities.name: Agile Wit
abilities.description: Treat Speed tasks and their Effort costs as Intellect tasks when you choose.

abilities.name: Using the Environment
abilities.description: Nearby cover grants cover and a melee asset; move across reachable obstacles and difficult terrain freely until recovery.

abilities.name: Again and Again
abilities.description: Take an extra action on your turn.

abilities.name: Return to Sender
abilities.description: After successfully blocking or dodging a melee attack, immediately attack its source; wait until after your normal turn to use this again.
